name: Snover
flavor_text: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain’s lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.

name: Abomasnow
flavor_text: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

text.name: Freezing Disaster
text.text: Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) can't be healed.

name: Smoliv
flavor_text: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

text.name: Nutrients
text.text: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

name: Dolliv

text.name: Apply Oil

name: Arboliva
flavor_text: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

text.name: Enriching Oil
text.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may heal all damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

name: Toedscool
flavor_text: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

text.text: Put this Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand.

name: Frigibax
flavor_text: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

text.name: Collect
text.text: Draw a card.

name: Arctibax
flavor_text: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

name: Baxcalibur
flavor_text: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.

text.name: Super Cold
text.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Basic {W} Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

name: Pikachu
flavor_text: ﻿When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

text.name: Growl
text.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 20 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

name: Raichu
flavor_text: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

text.name: Electrical Grounding
text.text: When 1 of your Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, you may move a {L} Energy from that Pokémon to this Pokémon.

text.name: Thunder
text.text: This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.

name: Voltorb
flavor_text: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

text.name: Tumbling Attack
text.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

name: Electrode
flavor_text: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

text.name: Bang Boom Chain
text.text: Before doing damage, you may discard any number of Pokémon Tools from your Pokémon. This attack does 40 more damage for each card you discarded in this way.

name: Shinx
flavor_text: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

text.name: Wild Kick
text.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

name: Luxio
flavor_text: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

name: Luxray
flavor_text: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.

text.name: Swelling Flash
text.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in your hand and you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, you may put this Pokémon onto your Bench.

text.name: Wild Charge
text.text: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

name: Pachirisu
flavor_text: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

text.name: Electricity Pouches
text.text: This Pokémon can't be Paralyzed.

text.name: Everyone Discharge
text.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each of your Benched {L} Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness.

name: Thundurus
flavor_text: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over the place and causes forest fires. It is therefore disliked.

text.name: Adverse Weather
text.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, prevent all damage done to your Benched Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.

text.name: Gigantic Bolt
text.text: This Pokémon also does 90 damage to itself.

name: Toxel
flavor_text: It has no problem drinking dirty water. An organ inside Toxel’s body filters such water into a poisonous liquid that is harmless to Toxel.

text.name: Slight Intrusion
text.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

name: Toxtricity
flavor_text: Many youths admire the way this Pokémon listlessly picks fights and keeps its cool no matter what opponent it faces.

text.name: Leer
text.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.name: Loud Mix
text.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each different type of Pokémon on your Bench.

name: Pawmi
flavor_text: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

name: Pawmo
flavor_text: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.

text.name: Thunder Shock
text.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

name: Pawmot
flavor_text: Pawmot’s fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.

text.name: Electrogenesis
text.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Basic {L} Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.name: Electro Paws
text.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

name: Wattrel
flavor_text: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

text.name: United Wings
text.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the United Wings attack.

name: Kilowattrel
flavor_text: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

text.name: United Thunder
text.text: This attack does 10 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the United Wings attack to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

name: Wigglytuff
flavor_text: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.

text.name: Balloon Therapy
text.text: Once during your turn, you may attach a Therapeutic Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

name: Abra
flavor_text: Abra can teleport in its sleep. Apparently the more deeply Abra sleeps, the farther its teleportations go.

name: Kadabra
flavor_text: This Pokémon’s telekinesis is immensely powerful. To prepare for evolution, Kadabra stores up psychic energy in the star on its forehead.

text.name: Teleportation Attack
text.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

name: Cleffa
flavor_text: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

text.name: Grasping Draw
text.text: Draw cards until you have 7 cards in your hand.

name: Natu
flavor_text: Because its wings aren’t yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.

text.name: Triple Strike
text.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

name: Xatu
flavor_text: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.

text.name: Clairvoyant Sense
text.text: Once during your turn, you may attach a Basic {P} Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you attached Energy to a Pokémon in this way, draw 2 cards.

name: Ralts
flavor_text: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people’s emotions.

name: Kirlia
flavor_text: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

text.name: Psychic
text.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Drifloon
flavor_text: It is whispered that any child who mistakes Drifloon for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.

text.name: Balloon Blast
text.text: This attack does 30 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

name: Drifblim
flavor_text: It can generate and release gas within its body. That’s how it can control the altitude of its drift.

text.name: Curse Spreading
text.text: Put 8 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

name: Mime Jr.
flavor_text: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy’s movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!

text.name: Mimed Games
text.text: Your opponent chooses an attack from 1 of their Pokémon in play. Use the chosen attack as this attack.

name: Spiritomb
flavor_text: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

text.name: Fettered in Misfortune
text.text: Basic Pokémon V in play (both yours and your opponent's) have no Abilities.

text.name: Fade Out
text.text: Put this Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand.

name: Klefki
flavor_text: In the past, noble families entrusted their vault keys to a Klefki. They passed the Klefki down through the generations, taking good care of it.

text.name: Mischievous Lock
text.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, Basic Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) have no Abilities, except for Mischievous Lock.

text.name: Joust
text.text: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Mimikyu
flavor_text: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

text.name: Safeguard
text.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon ex and Pokémon V.

text.name: Ghost Eye
text.text: Put 7 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Dachsbun
flavor_text: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon’s body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

text.name: Well-Baked Body
text.text: This Pokémon can't be Burned. Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's {R} Pokémon.

name: Ceruledge
flavor_text: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

text.name: Life Sucker
text.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

text.name: Fighting Sword
text.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex or Pokémon V, this attack does 100 more damage.

name: Rabsca
flavor_text: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

text.name: Revival Blessing
text.text: Put a Pokémon from your discard pile onto your Bench.

text.name: Psybeam
text.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

name: Flittle
flavor_text: Flittle’s toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon’s belly.

text.name: Psy Bolt
text.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

name: Tinkatink
flavor_text: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

text.name: Scrap Pickup
text.text: Put an Item card from your discard pile into your hand.

name: Tinkatuff
flavor_text: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

text.name: Play Rough
text.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

text.name: Pulverizing Press
text.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Tinkaton
flavor_text: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.

text.name: Gather Materials
text.text: You must discard a card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw 3 cards.

text.name: Special Hammer
text.text: If this Pokémon has any Special Energy attached, this attack does 90 more damage.

name: Houndstone
flavor_text: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn’t like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.

text.name: Last Respects
text.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each {P} Pokémon in your discard pile.

name: Mankey
flavor_text: It is extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment, then thrashing away the next instant.

text.name: Monkey Beatdown
text.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

name: Primeape
flavor_text: Some researchers theorize that Primeape remains angry even when inside a Poké Ball.

text.name: Raging Punch
text.text: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

name: Annihilape
flavor_text: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

text.name: Rage Fist
text.text: This attack does 70 damage for each Prize card your opponent has taken.

text.name: Dynamite Punch
text.text: This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.

name: Paldean Tauros
flavor_text: This kind of Tauros, known as the Combat Breed, is distinguished by its thick, powerful muscles and its fierce disposition.

text.name: Raging Horns
text.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

text.name: Combat Tackle
text.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

name: Riolu
flavor_text: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

text.name: Reckless Charge
text.text: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

name: Lucario
flavor_text: It’s said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras—even those of foes it could not otherwise see.

text.name: Avenging Knuckle
text.text: If any of your {F} Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 120 more damage.

text.name: Accelerating Stab
text.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Accelerating Stab.

name: Hawlucha
flavor_text: Its elegant finishing moves—performed by nimbly leaping around using its wings—are polished in the forest where it was born and raised.

text.name: Flying Entry
text.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may choose 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and put 1 damage counter on each of them.

name: Nacli
flavor_text: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

text.name: Salt Coating
text.text: Heal 20 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

name: Naclstack
flavor_text: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey’s body.

text.name: Salt Cannon
text.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 60 damage for each heads.

name: Garganacl
flavor_text: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

text.name: Blessed Salt
text.text: During Pokémon Checkup, heal 20 damage from each of your Pokémon.

text.name: Knocking Hammer
text.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

name: Glimmet
flavor_text: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.

text.name: Ascension
text.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Paldean Wooper
flavor_text: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

text.name: Find a Home
text.text: Search your deck for a Stadium card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Murkrow
flavor_text: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

text.name: Spin Turn
text.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

text.name: United Wings
text.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the United Wings attack.

name: Sneasel
flavor_text: This cunning Pokémon hides under the cover of darkness, waiting to attack its prey.

name: Weavile
flavor_text: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

text.name: Assaulting Hunt
text.text: Once during your turn, when this Pokémon moves from your Bench to the Active Spot, you may switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Basic Pokémon to the Active Spot.

name: Sableye
flavor_text: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

text.name: Night Eyes
text.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

text.name: Unseen Claw
text.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, this attack does 70 more damage.

name: Pawniard
flavor_text: Pawniard will fearlessly challenge even powerful foes. In a pinch, it will cling to opponents and pierce them with the blades all over its body.

name: Bisharp
flavor_text: This Pokémon commands a group of several Pawniard. Groups that are defeated in territorial disputes are absorbed by the winning side.

text.name: Double-Edged Slash
text.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

name: Kingambit
flavor_text: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.

text.name: Leadership
text.text: Your Basic Pokémon's attacks do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

name: Mabosstiff
flavor_text: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

text.name: Intimidating Howl
text.text: Once during your turn, you may switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

text.name: Wild Tackle
text.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

name: Shroodle
flavor_text: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.

text.name: Berry Search
text.text: Put a Basic Energy card from your discard pile into your hand.

name: Grafaiai
flavor_text: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.

text.name: Spit Poison
text.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

text.name: Colorful Graffiti
text.text: You may discard as many Basic Energy cards as you like from your hand. This attack does 40 damage for each type of Basic Energy you discarded in this way.

name: Scizor
flavor_text: This Pokémon’s pincers, which contain steel, can crush any hard object they get ahold of into bits.

text.name: Punishing Scissors
text.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each of your opponent's Pokémon in play that has an Ability.

name: Varoom
flavor_text: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

text.name: Rev
text.text: Put up to 2 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.

name: Revavroom
flavor_text: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders— now numbering eight—to generate energy.

text.name: Rumbling Engine
text.text: You must discard an Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

text.name: Knock Away
text.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 90 more damage.

name: Noibat
flavor_text: This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from its large ears to search for fruit to eat. It mistakes Applin for its food.

name: Cyclizar
flavor_text: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

text.name: Acceleration Drive
text.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

name: Pidgey
flavor_text: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.

text.name: Call for Family
text.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Pidgeotto
flavor_text: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

name: Jigglypuff
flavor_text: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

text.name: Lead
text.text: Search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.name: Stompy Stomp
text.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

name: Doduo
flavor_text: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

text.name: Reckless Charge
text.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

name: Dodrio
flavor_text: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.

text.name: Zooming Draw
text.text: Once during your turn, you may put 1 damage counter on this Pokémon. If you do, draw a card.

text.name: Ballistic Beak
text.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

name: Ditto
flavor_text: Its transformation ability is perfect. However, if made to laugh, it can’t maintain its disguise.

text.name: Transformative Start
text.text: Once during your first turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may search your deck and choose a Basic Pokémon you find there, except any Ditto. If you do, discard this Pokémon and all attached cards, and put the chosen Pokémon in its place. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Snorlax
flavor_text: This Pokémon’s stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.

text.name: Voraciousness
text.text: Once during your turn, you may put up to 2 Leftovers cards from your discard pile into your hand.

text.name: Thudding Press
text.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

name: Wingull
flavor_text: It soars high in the sky, riding on updrafts like a glider. It carries food tucked in its bill.

name: Pelipper
flavor_text: It is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon in its beak. It bobs on the waves to rest its wings.

text.name: Hearsay
text.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may choose 1: put a Supporter card from your discard pile into your hand; or search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, put it into your hand, and then shuffle your deck.

name: Skwovet
flavor_text: No matter how much it stuffs its belly with food, it is always anxious about getting hungry again. So, it stashes berries in its cheeks and tail.

text.name: Nest Stash
text.text: Once during your turn, you may shuffle your hand and put it on the bottom of your deck. If you put any cards on the bottom of your deck in this way, draw a card.

name: Greedent
flavor_text: This Pokémon makes off with heaps of fallen berries by wrapping them in its tail, which is roughly twice the length of its body.

text.name: Enhanced Fang
text.text: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 80 more damage.

name: Lechonk
flavor_text: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn’t use it for anything other than foraging.

text.name: Whimsy Tackle
text.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

name: Oinkologne
flavor_text: This Pokémon sends a flowerlike scent wafting about. Well-developed muscles in its legs allow it to leap more than 16 feet with no trouble at all.

text.name: Finest Selection
text.text: Flip 3 coins. Put a number of cards up to the number of heads from your discard pile into your hand.

text.name: Perfume Press
text.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

name: Tandemaus
flavor_text: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

text.name: Collect
text.text: Draw 2 cards.

name: Maushold
flavor_text: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

text.name: Family Attack
text.text: This attack does 70 damage for each of your Maushold in play.

name: Flamigo
flavor_text: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

text.name: Insta-Flock
text.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 3 Flamigo, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.name: United Wings
text.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the United Wings attack.

text.name: Tera
text.text: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent’s).

text.name: Exploding Energy
text.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 5 Basic {G} Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck. If you searched your deck in this way, this Pokémon is Knocked Out.

text.name: Guard Press
text.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

text.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.text: Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent's Pokémon done to all of your Pokémon that have Energy attached. (Existing effects are not removed. Damage is not an effect.)

text.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, attacks used by your opponent's Active Pokémon cost {C} more.

text.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to both Active Pokémon.

text.name: Pokémon ex rule
text.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

text.text: This attack can be used even if this Pokémon is on the Bench.

text.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.

text.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Basic {P} Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your {P} Pokémon. If you attached Energy to a Pokémon in this way, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon. You can't use this Ability on a Pokémon that would be Knocked Out.

text.text: This Pokémon recovers from all Special Conditions.

text.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent can't have more than 3 Benched Pokémon. text.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

text.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.text: Once during your turn, if a Stadium is in play, you may make your opponent's Active Pokémon Poisoned.

text.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Basic Pokémon.

text.name: Dominating Echo
text.text: During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Special Energy or Stadium cards from their hand.

text.name: Pokémon ex rule
text.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Quick Search
text.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You can't use more than 1 Quick Search Ability each turn.

text.name: Blustery Wind
text.text: You may discard a Stadium in play.

text.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.text: If this Pokémon has any Special Energy attached, it gets +100 HP.

text.text: If you played a Supporter card from your hand during this turn, this attack does 90 more damage.
